piece.caption:
How to edit invoices, rate lists, and spreadsheets directly inside Google Gemini chat without switching tabs.

When you ask Gemini to create a stock register or draft a quotation, you no longer have to download it to correct a minor figure. You can expand the file into full-screen mode, highlight the exact table or sentence, and instruct Gemini to recalculate the numbers or turn a table into a graph.

One practical catch: if you are reviewing on your phone, only PDF editing works right now. For Google Sheets and Docs, use your office desktop browser.

Which file type do you update most often during the workday: PDFs, Docs, or Sheets?

Stevie Bonifield is a news writer covering all things consumer tech. Stevie started out at Laptop Mag writing news and reviews on hardware, gaming, and AI. Now you can generate, preview, and edit PDFs, Google Docs, Google Sheets, slide decks, Markdown files, TXT files, and code directly within Google Gemini . The new file editing capabilities are available starting today for all Gemini users, and while PDF previews/editing works on both the web and mobile, all other file formats are only in the web version for now.
Google added support for generating and downloading files in Gemini earlier this year, but now you can tweak those files without leaving the Gemini app. Google says you can expand documents to edit them in full-screen mode and highlight text in files to ask Gemini questions or prompt it to make changes to the file, like highlighting a table and asking Gemini to turn it into a graph.
You could already use Gemini to edit files with its integrations in Google’s Workspace apps, like the Gemini bar in Google Docs . Anthropic also launched a feature earlier this year that allows users to generate and edit documents and presentations in Claude chats.
